summary:
Reviewed w200's commits 1e0eabf6, 5e486d94, 5b198dc9 (rebased copies of the listed cab55fa6, c42d0188/208bb0e9, 6b86baff; same subjects, identical code).
No test weakened. Retiring the deprecated r131 outline is allowed by Retires. All four setup allowances hold.
Fix now (Important): supervise_outputs.unformulated counts term/<term> ids from a proposal's adds/changes as requirements with no scenario. So a proposal that adds or changes a term (i38's own proposal changes term/fault, term/outcome, term/stage) is always asked and never formulated. A probe confirmed it.
Observation: ranges like thing#r1-r3 are not expanded.
Minor: ruff I001 import order in supervise_rounds.py.
size: nothing over 300. vulture: one already-present unused variable.
questions: Important, scripts/supervise_outputs.py:44-55 (called from scripts/supervise_rounds.py:150-152): the formulate check treats term/<term> ids in a proposal's adds/changes as requirements with no scenario, so any proposal adding or changing a term is asked forever and never formulated; take only <capability>#r<n> ids.
